entries.zh: 懂得技艺、学问；通晓、有知识
entries.en: to know an art, a science, etc.; to be learned, knowledgeable
entries.notes: M 栏空白；R 栏「bat」与「chay hang ty sit」两段对应关系未明，释义以 L 栏「saber arte, ciencia」及 H 栏「認」为据。

entries.zh: 会讲道理、能说出个所以然来
entries.en: to know how to state one's reasons, to speak sense
entries.notes: M 栏空白且 R 栏「lou bun」与 H 栏「吻」（口）难以互证；释义仅据 L 栏「saber decir su razón」定，存疑。

entries.zh: 好奇好问、爱刨根问底
entries.en: to know inquisitively; curious in asking questions
entries.notes: M 栏空白，H 栏单字「格」与「curioso en preguntar」之对应依赖推断（或取「格物」穷究义），存疑。

entries.zh: 认识、认得；认（辨认）
entries.en: to know, to be acquainted with; to recognize
entries.notes: H 栏「認」与 L 栏「saber conocer」密合；R 栏仅一音节「xin」，与「認」官话对音不合，疑有截断。

entries.zh: 认识、相识；经历过而知道（识经过）
entries.en: to know, to be acquainted with; to know through experience

entries.zh: 口吻：说话的口气、腔调
entries.en: tone, manner of speech; to know (how) to speak
entries.notes: L 栏仅「saber.」（疑有截断）；据 H「口」M「吻」与 R「cou bun」推为「口吻」，与词条对应存疑。

entries.zh: 在行：内行、精通其事
entries.en: to be expert, conversant in (a trade); to know the business
entries.notes: 四栏语义互证（H「在」M「行」R「chai hang」＝在行）；因 M 栏污损难辨号（T99）降中。

entries.zh: 知识：知道、学识
entries.en: knowledge; to know

entries.zh: 谙练：熟练、精通、老练
entries.en: to know perfectly; well-versed, practiced, expert
entries.notes: H「諳」M「練」R「am lien」互证明确；因 M 栏污损难辨号（T99）降中。

entries.zh: 识香臭：知道好歹、能辨好坏
entries.en: to know good from bad (lit. to know fragrant from stinking)
entries.notes: 四栏互证明确；因 M 栏污损难辨号（T99）降中。

entries.zh: 识艰苦：尝过甘苦、知好知歹
entries.en: to know hardship; to have known both good and bad
entries.notes: H「識」M「艱苦」R「bat can cou」互证；右缘批注「chay tau bue」＝知头尾（与第 16 条同形）；因 T99 降中。

entries.zh: 识咸酸苦淡：历尽酸甜苦辣、识尽人生百味
entries.en: to know all flavours (salty, sour, bitter, bland); to have tasted life's ups and downs
entries.notes: M 栏四字明写「鹹酸苦淡」；R 栏末音节与「淡」对音未尽合，释义以 M 栏为据；因 T99 降中。

entries.zh: 识到底：知道得透彻、底细全知
entries.en: to know it all, thoroughly; to know to the bottom
entries.notes: 四栏互证明确；因 M 栏污损难辨号（T99）降中。

entries.zh: 识到详细：知道得详尽周详
entries.en: to know it fully, in detail
entries.notes: 四栏互证明确；因 M 栏污损难辨号（T99）降中。

entries.zh: 识江湖：通晓世情、深谙世事
entries.en: to know the ways of the world; worldly-wise
entries.notes: L 同「saber lo todo」，M 栏「江湖」取世事人情义；因 T99 降中。

entries.zh: 知头尾：来龙去脉都知道
entries.en: to know a thing from head to tail; to know the whole story
entries.notes: 四栏互证明确；因 M 栏污损难辨号（T99）降中。

entries.zh: 识一个皮：只知皮毛、略知表面
entries.en: to know only the surface (lit. 'to know one skin'); superficial knowledge
entries.notes: 四栏互证明确；因 M 栏污损难辨号（T99）降中。

entries.zh: 懂事：识事体、会处世
entries.en: to know how to conduct oneself (crianza, upbringing/manners); to know affairs
entries.notes: L 栏「criancia」带截断号且 M 栏仅单字「事」；「识事」＝懂事知礼之解依赖推断，存疑。

entries.zh: 识小礼：懂得小节礼数
entries.en: to know (small) courtesies, good manners
entries.notes: L「saber de criancia」与 M「小禮」密合；因 M 栏污损难辨号（T99）降中。

entries.zh: 识礼：知礼数、有教养
entries.en: to know courtesy, etiquette; well-mannered
entries.notes: 四栏互证明确；因 M 栏污损难辨号（T99）降中。

entries.zh: 有面目：有体面、有脸面（知分寸而得体）
entries.en: to have face, standing; to know what is fitting
entries.notes: M「有面目」字面为「有体面」，与 L「saber lo que conviene」（知分寸）之对应依赖推断（居礼数词条簇中故取此解）；因 T99 降中。

entries.zh: 〔原件残缺，释义存疑〕
entries.en: gloss uncertain (source damaged/illegible)
entries.notes: M 栏次字残损（墨渍，仅辨「灼」形，不成词）；L「saber más」（更懂得、更高明）与 H「高」、R「co chiag」难以互证。

entries.zh: 懂得不多；仅会一点
entries.en: to know little; to know only a little
entries.notes: M「會」与 L「saber poco」大体相承，但 H「句」与 R「cu ey」难以互证（疑有截误），中文字面无法定夺。
